facts.name: Lester B. Bass
facts.assignment: Nassau Circuit Court Division C; published practice guide principally addresses family-law operations.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant phone; mailing address from retained official addendum. No separate personal judge email or fax established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number, name and matter; copy parties unless authorized ex parte.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first, coordinate all parties and obtain court confirmation; offered times are not held. Use assistant and published schedule for the applicable hearing route; confirm cancellations.

proposed_orders.summary: Guide directs Word proposed orders to assistant by email, copied to parties, with agreement/disagreement cover letter; ordinarily within five business days of hearing unless court directs otherwise.

remote_appearances.summary: Guide requires a remote request five days beforehand; linked addendum instead states default Zoom unless in-person notice three business days beforehand. Preserve both statements and consult current court directions.

conflicts: Remote-request and default-Zoom statements differ between guide and addendum; neither is selected as controlling.
Prior3663review preserves differing exhibit-material timing, volume and ADA contact statements. Detailed noncivil provisions not reanalyzed; originals remain available.
gaps: No separately published personal judge email or fax in checked guide; assistant contact retained. Source documents do not state revision dates.

review_scope.content_reviewed: Identity/contact and basic scheduling, communications, submission and remote requirements; prior source discrepancies reused.
